title: Awesome BTCfi
scope: A broad, curated and source-reviewed directory; not an exhaustive census or investment recommendation.

entries.name: Alkanes
entries.description: WASM-based metaprotocol supporting programmable assets and DeFi logic.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Bitcoin witness data interpreted by a metaprotocol runtime and indexer.
entries.review_focus: Runtime correctness, indexer agreement and upgrade rules.
entries.status_note: Contract execution is not Bitcoin Core executing a general-purpose VM.

entries.name: Ark
entries.description: Shared-UTXO payment design with virtual UTXOs and a coordinating server.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Prearranged Bitcoin transaction trees and off-chain transfers.
entries.review_focus: Server availability, refresh deadlines, transfer assumptions and unilateral exit costs.
entries.status_note: Implementations differ; see Arkade and Second.

entries.name: BitVM
entries.description: Off-chain computation with Bitcoin-enforced dispute mechanisms, used in bridge and rollup designs.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Fraud-proof constructions using existing Bitcoin scripting capabilities.
entries.review_focus: Version-specific challengers, setup, liquidity and dispute assumptions.
entries.status_note: BitVM is a construction family; its existence does not prove a particular bridge is deployed or safe.

entries.name: BRC-20
entries.description: Inscription-based token experiment with off-chain balance interpretation.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Deploy, mint and transfer inscriptions interpreted by indexers.
entries.review_focus: Indexer agreement, evolving protocol rules and token liquidity.
entries.status_note: Original specification is historical; it points to Layer 1 Foundation for evolving documentation.

entries.name: Discreet Log Contracts (DLCs)
entries.description: Oracle-attested Bitcoin contracts for contingent payments, derivatives and collateral arrangements.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Bitcoin transactions with outcomes selected using oracle signatures.
entries.review_focus: Oracle accuracy and availability, contract construction and refund paths.
entries.status_note: A contract family, not a single lending platform.

entries.name: Lightning Network
entries.description: Payment channels that route BTC off-chain and can settle to Bitcoin.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Bitcoin channel transactions and timelocked settlement.
entries.review_focus: Channel backups, online monitoring, liquidity and on-chain exit fees.
entries.status_note: Protocol overview reviewed; individual wallet custody varies.

entries.name: OP_NET
entries.description: Smart-contract execution system that embeds contract data in Bitcoin transactions.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Additional execution and verification rules applied to Bitcoin witness data.
entries.review_focus: Execution consensus, indexing, contract security and network-specific deployment stage.
entries.status_note: Documentation reviewed; this entry does not certify mainnet deployment or inherit marketing security claims.

entries.name: Ordinals
entries.description: Satoshi indexing and inscriptions underlying collectible markets and collateral use cases.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Bitcoin transactions interpreted by ordinal-aware software.
entries.review_focus: Indexer conventions, UTXO handling, fees and collectible liquidity.
entries.status_note: Adjacent infrastructure, not an intrinsic BTC yield mechanism.

entries.name: RGB
entries.description: Client-validated contracts and asset issuance anchored to Bitcoin outputs.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Off-chain contract state and proofs associated with Bitcoin ownership.
entries.review_focus: Proof backups, wallet interoperability and issuer terms.
entries.status_note: Issued assets are distinct from native BTC.

entries.name: RGB++
entries.description: Asset protocol connecting Bitcoin UTXOs and CKB cells through isomorphic bindings.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Asset ownership bindings across Bitcoin and CKB.
entries.review_focus: CKB dependencies and the separate custody model of any BTC wrapper.
entries.status_note: Distinct from RGB; token movement does not by itself make native BTC bridge-free.

entries.name: Runes
entries.description: Fungible-token metaprotocol with balances assigned to Bitcoin outputs.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Runestones encoded in Bitcoin transactions.
entries.review_focus: Indexer correctness, token economics, market liquidity and fee costs.
entries.status_note: Rune tokens are separate assets, not bitcoin.

entries.name: Taproot Assets
entries.description: Asset issuance and transfers using Taproot, including Lightning-based transfers.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Bitcoin commitments, client-side asset proofs and Lightning channels.
entries.review_focus: Issuer backing, proof availability, wallet compatibility and channel liquidity.
entries.status_note: An issuance protocol; a dollar token adds its own issuer risk.

entries.name: Alpen
entries.description: EVM-compatible validity-rollup project for programmable Bitcoin applications.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Validity proofs with Bitcoin consensus and data availability in the documented design.
entries.review_focus: Testnet limitations, bridge construction and eventual mainnet controls.
entries.status_note: Docs explicitly describe a work-in-progress rollup on Bitcoin signet; mainnet is a future release.

entries.name: Arch Network
entries.description: Financial application infrastructure designed around native Bitcoin settlement.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: External execution and signing infrastructure connected to Bitcoin transactions.
entries.review_focus: Validator or signer control, settlement guarantees and the current application design.
entries.status_note: Native settlement language does not eliminate the need to review the execution and signing layer.

entries.name: B2 Network
entries.description: Bitcoin extension ecosystem with rollup infrastructure, bridges and application products.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: B2 Hub, execution network and separate asset bridges.
entries.review_focus: Bridge control, data availability, proof verification and current product scope.
entries.status_note: Official product navigation includes B2 Hub, Rollup and BTC Bridge.

entries.name: BitcoinOS
entries.description: BitSNARK and Grail-related infrastructure for Bitcoin proofs, bridges and interoperable applications.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Proof and bridge constructions intended to connect external computation to Bitcoin.
entries.review_focus: Implementation maturity, custody, proof challenge assumptions and each integration's deployment.
entries.status_note: Infrastructure claims reviewed; no blanket mainnet or trustlessness assertion.

entries.name: Bitlayer
entries.description: Bitcoin execution ecosystem associated with BitVM infrastructure and the YBTC product family.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Separate execution and product-specific Bitcoin bridge arrangements.
entries.review_focus: Current deployment versus whitepaper design, custody and withdrawal conditions.
entries.status_note: Homepage now emphasizes YBTC; distinguish the network from individual products.

entries.name: BOB
entries.description: Hybrid-chain ecosystem with Bitcoin intents, DeFi access and Bitcoin vault development.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: EVM execution plus route-dependent bridging, intents and BitVM-related infrastructure.
entries.review_focus: Current chain stage, privileged roles and the exact bridge or vault used.
entries.status_note: Docs describe several products; do not assign one security model to all of them.

entries.name: Citrea
entries.description: Bitcoin rollup project with EVM applications and the Clementine cBTC bridge.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Validity proofs and a BitVM-based bridge architecture.
entries.review_focus: Bridge challengers and operators, exit liquidity, sequencer and upgrade controls.
entries.status_note: Official homepage states that mainnet is live; no transaction testing performed.

entries.name: Fractal Bitcoin
entries.description: Bitcoin-code-based scaling ecosystem supporting asset protocols and applications.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Separate SHA256d network with its own asset and consensus arrangements.
entries.review_focus: Separate-chain security and the custody of any asset bridged from Bitcoin.
entries.status_note: FB is not BTC; compatibility with Bitcoin software does not imply identical security.

entries.name: GOAT Network
entries.description: Bitcoin-oriented execution ecosystem advertising BTC fee income and programmable applications.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Separate execution network, bridge and operator arrangements.
entries.review_focus: BTC entry and exit path, operators, upgrades and fees versus token incentives.
entries.status_note: BTC-denominated fees and GOATED rewards are distinct reward sources.

entries.name: Hemi
entries.description: Bitcoin and Ethereum ecosystem offering programmable BTC-related finance and institutional access.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Hemi execution with product-specific Bitcoin access and custody paths.
entries.review_focus: Settlement architecture, bridge or custody route and strategy dependencies.
entries.status_note: HEMI token staking is not the same thing as staking BTC.

entries.name: Liquid Network
entries.description: Federated Bitcoin sidechain for confidential transfers, asset issuance and capital markets.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: BTC is represented as L-BTC on a federation-operated sidechain.
entries.review_focus: Federation control, peg-out access and issuer risk for non-BTC assets.
entries.status_note: Sidechain settlement has additional trust assumptions beyond Bitcoin.

entries.name: Merlin Chain
entries.description: EVM-compatible ecosystem supporting Bitcoin-linked assets and applications.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: A separate network with bridged Bitcoin assets and proof infrastructure.
entries.review_focus: Bridge custody, oracle and data availability assumptions, upgrades and exits.
entries.status_note: Rollup branding is not treated as proof of Bitcoin-enforced withdrawals.

entries.name: Rootstock
entries.description: Bitcoin-oriented EVM sidechain hosting lending, stablecoins and trading.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: RBTC peg and a separate smart-contract execution network.
entries.review_focus: Powpeg custody, bridge delays, network consensus and application contracts.
entries.status_note: The official site identifies Rootstock as a Bitcoin sidechain.

entries.name: Stacks
entries.description: Smart-contract network for Bitcoin applications, including lending and exchanges using sBTC.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Separate execution with Bitcoin anchoring and an sBTC signer-based peg.
entries.review_focus: Signer custody, execution rules, upgrades and withdrawal mechanics.
entries.status_note: Treat Stacks execution and sBTC custody as separate review questions.

entries.name: BTC.b
entries.description: Non-yield BTC representation operated by Lombard, originally launched by Ava Labs.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: BTC backing with Lombard consortium and chain-specific transfer infrastructure.
entries.review_focus: Consortium custody, supported-chain changes and redemption paths.
entries.status_note: Lombard docs report acquisition in October 2025; September 2026 chain support changes require separate review.

entries.name: BTCB
entries.description: Binance-issued Bitcoin representation used in the BNB Chain ecosystem.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Custodial BTC backing and destination-chain tokens.
entries.review_focus: Binance custody, reserve verification, redemption and smart-contract permissions.
entries.status_note: BTCB is distinct from native BTC and from unrelated similarly named tokens.

entries.name: cbBTC
entries.description: Coinbase-backed BTC representation for on-chain collateral and trading.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: BTC held by Coinbase with tokens issued on supported networks.
entries.review_focus: Custody, issuer controls, redemption eligibility and chain-specific bridge design.
entries.status_note: The cited technical assessment distinguishes canonical cbBTC from a bridged deployment.

entries.name: ckBTC
entries.description: Chain-key BTC representation managed by Internet Computer canisters.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Threshold signatures, ICP subnets and minter/ledger canisters.
entries.review_focus: ICP consensus and governance, canister upgrades, transaction screening and redemption.
entries.status_note: No traditional single custodian does not mean no additional trust assumptions.

entries.name: Clementine and cBTC
entries.description: Citrea's bridge and BTC representation for its application environment.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: BitVM-based optimistic verification in the documented bridge design.
entries.review_focus: Operator and challenger requirements, withdrawal liquidity and dispute windows.
entries.status_note: The whitepaper specifies an honest watchtower assumption within a permissioned set; implementation and deployed configuration require separate review.

entries.name: FBTC
entries.description: Bitcoin representation connecting custodial BTC reserves to destination-chain tokens.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: On-chain contracts combined with off-chain custody operations.
entries.review_focus: Custody policy, pausing, upgrades and safety-committee emergency powers.
entries.status_note: Distinct from the FBTC ticker used by a Bitcoin ETF.

entries.name: L-BTC
entries.description: Liquid's Bitcoin-pegged settlement asset.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: BTC locked under the Liquid federation's peg arrangements.
entries.review_focus: Federation behavior, peg-out access and network liveness.
entries.status_note: Holding L-BTC is not identical to holding a Bitcoin L1 UTXO.

entries.name: sBTC
entries.description: BTC-backed asset used by applications on Stacks.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Bitcoin deposits controlled through the sBTC signer system.
entries.review_focus: Signer threshold, withdrawals, upgrades and application-level risk.
entries.status_note: Distinct from Synthetix's historical sBTC ticker.

entries.name: strkBTC
entries.description: Bitcoin representation on Starknet with optional shielded balances and staking integrations.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Bitcoin bridging plus Starknet token and privacy infrastructure.
entries.review_focus: Bridge backing, shielding controls, recovery and staking dependencies.
entries.status_note: Privacy features do not remove the bridge's custody assumptions.

entries.name: tBTC
entries.description: Threshold Network's Bitcoin bridge asset for DeFi.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Threshold-signing custody rather than a single traditional custodian.
entries.review_focus: Signer thresholds, bridge governance, redemption and destination-chain contracts.
entries.status_note: Review the current tBTC version, not assumptions from the earlier v1 system.

entries.name: WBTC
entries.description: Custodially backed Bitcoin representation used across DeFi markets.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: BTC reserves, authorized merchants and token contracts on destination chains.
entries.review_focus: Custodian arrangements, mint and redemption access, freeze controls and additional bridge layers.
entries.status_note: A BTC wrapper, not a yield product by itself.

entries.name: Babylon Bitcoin Staking
entries.description: Bitcoin collateral used to provide security to external proof-of-stake systems.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Bitcoin staking scripts and finality-provider delegation.
entries.review_focus: Slashing conditions, unbonding time, covenant rules and reward denomination.
entries.status_note: This does not change Bitcoin consensus from proof of work to proof of stake.

entries.name: Core
entries.description: EVM network with BTC timelock-based delegation and CORE rewards.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Bitcoin CLTV timelocks help elect Core validators.
entries.review_focus: Lock duration, validator performance, CORE exposure and separate risks when using Core DeFi.
entries.status_note: Official description distinguishes BTC timelocking from bridging; dual staking also requires CORE.

entries.name: Endur
entries.description: Liquid staking infrastructure for BTC representations and STRK on Starknet.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Receipt tokens backed by product-specific staking positions.
entries.review_focus: Underlying wrapper, staking contracts, token exchange rate and redemption.
entries.status_note: Official site states Starknet mainnet availability; BTC and STRK products are distinct.

entries.name: Pell Network
entries.description: Restaking platform using BTC representations and liquid staking derivatives for shared security.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Restaked collateral securing decentralized validated services.
entries.review_focus: Underlying wrapper custody, operators, service-specific slashing and reward tokens.
entries.status_note: Terms depend on the particular asset and service selected.

entries.name: PumpBTC
entries.description: Liquid Bitcoin staking contracts minting pumpBTC from supported BTC representations.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Operator-mediated conversion and Babylon staking in the published contract description.
entries.review_focus: Operator custody, wrapper backing, upgrade roles and unstaking terms.
entries.status_note: Code reviewed; current user-facing service availability was not established.

entries.name: SatLayer
entries.description: Shared-security contracts on Babylon for Bitcoin Validated Services.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Wrapped BTC or BTC liquid staking tokens allocated to service security.
entries.review_focus: Underlying assets, operators, contracts and whether a given vault enables slashing.
entries.status_note: Do not assume every displayed vault has the same slashing configuration.

entries.name: Stacking DAO
entries.description: Liquid staking products for BTC and STX, including stBTC, stSTX and stSTXbtc.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Stacks staking mechanisms and liquid receipt tokens.
entries.review_focus: Asset identity, signer or contract dependencies, redemption and yield source.
entries.status_note: Current homepage offers BTC/sBTC deposits into stBTC; older STX-only descriptions are incomplete.

entries.name: Starknet Bitcoin staking
entries.description: Staking supported tokenized BTC on Starknet to receive STRK rewards.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: BTC wrapper tokens locked in Starknet staking contracts.
entries.review_focus: Wrapper and bridge security, validator rules, unbonding and STRK price exposure.
entries.status_note: Starknet is an Ethereum L2; this is not staking an unwrapped Bitcoin L1 UTXO.

entries.name: Aave
entries.description: Money markets supporting Bitcoin representations as collateral or supplied assets in selected markets.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Destination-chain contracts using tokens such as WBTC and cbBTC.
entries.review_focus: Market-specific collateral factors, oracles, liquidations and wrapper custody.
entries.status_note: BTC exposure on Aave generally adds wrapper and chain dependencies; separate native-collateral pilots need separate review.

entries.name: Avalon Labs
entries.description: Bitcoin-focused on-chain money markets, USDa borrowing and separate institutional credit products.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Product-specific smart contracts and, for CeDeFi loans, custodial collateral.
entries.review_focus: Identify on-chain versus institutional terms, custody, rates and liquidation controls.
entries.status_note: The site's On-Chain and CeDeFi products are separate trust models.

entries.name: Babylon Trustless Bitcoin Vaults
entries.description: Native BTC collateral infrastructure targeting applications such as external-chain borrowing.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: BTCVault construction with external recognition of Bitcoin collateral.
entries.review_focus: Actual testnet/mainnet stage, liquidation path, proof system and recovery conditions.
entries.status_note: Homepage's TBV access link points to a testnet app; the Aave integration is not labeled as a verified live lending market here.

entries.name: Debifi
entries.description: Connects Bitcoin borrowers with institutional lenders for fiat and stablecoin loans.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Dedicated 3-of-4 Bitcoin multisignature collateral escrow.
entries.review_focus: Key-holder roles, lender terms, identity checks and liquidation processes.
entries.status_note: Institutional lending marketplace; not an autonomous Bitcoin L1 money market.

entries.name: Firefish
entries.description: Marketplace for fiat or stablecoin loans secured by Bitcoin.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: On-chain multisignature escrow with off-chain loan settlement.
entries.review_focus: Escrow roles, default procedures, liquidation execution and legal counterparties.
entries.status_note: Combines Bitcoin collateral infrastructure with contractual lending relationships.

entries.name: Fluid
entries.description: Liquidity and lending infrastructure with WBTC-related markets.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Smart-contract vaults and a shared liquidity architecture.
entries.review_focus: Liquidations, oracle behavior, contract architecture and BTC wrapper custody.
entries.status_note: The cited proposal establishes WBTC market design; current live market parameters need app verification.

entries.name: Granite
entries.description: Bitcoin-backed borrowing with isolated collateral and partial liquidations.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: sBTC collateral in Stacks smart contracts.
entries.review_focus: sBTC peg, price oracles, liquidation execution and contract controls.
entries.status_note: The protocol says posted collateral is not re-lent; that does not remove liquidation risk.

entries.name: Lava
entries.description: Bitcoin-collateralized dollar borrowing and related spending services.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: BTC collateral arrangements linked to external loan and payment infrastructure.
entries.review_focus: Contract and key control, liquidation, funding counterparties and card eligibility.
entries.status_note: Self-custody marketing is not used here as an independent security certification.

entries.name: Lend at Hodl Hodl
entries.description: Marketplace for crypto loans secured by Bitcoin multisignature escrow.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: BTC collateral in a multisig contract; loan currency moves separately.
entries.review_focus: Counterparty performance, dispute resolution, LTV thresholds and contract recovery.
entries.status_note: Lenders need to inspect the loan currency; BTC collateral does not mean BTC-denominated lending.

entries.name: Lendasat
entries.description: Peer-to-peer loans with Bitcoin collateral and fiat or stablecoin settlement.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: 2-of-3 multisignature collateral with a dispute-resolution participant.
entries.review_focus: Counterparty repayment, dispute process, liquidation and recovery tools.
entries.status_note: Shared control is different from unilateral self-custody.

entries.name: Liquidium
entries.description: BTC loans secured by supported Ordinals or Runes, with lenders exposed to the collateral on default.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Bitcoin-native collateral contracts for the Bitcoin product.
entries.review_focus: Repayment deadlines, collectible valuation, collateral transfer and illiquidity.
entries.status_note: The site also has another-chain product; this listing covers Bitcoin loans.

entries.name: Morpho
entries.description: Isolated lending markets and curated vaults, including cbBTC collateral markets.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Token collateral in market-specific smart contracts.
entries.review_focus: Oracle selection, liquidation parameters, wrapper custody and vault-curator allocation.
entries.status_note: A market can exist permissionlessly without being endorsed by Morpho or this list.

entries.name: Sovryn
entries.description: Rootstock lending, collateralized borrowing and trading suite.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: RBTC and other supported assets in smart contracts.
entries.review_focus: Rootstock peg, contract governance, oracles and liquidation rules.
entries.status_note: Includes several subprotocols with different economics.

entries.name: Venus
entries.description: Money-market protocol with BTCB and other Bitcoin-related collateral markets.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Wrapped assets in destination-chain lending contracts.
entries.review_focus: Wrapper backing, oracle configuration, liquidations and governance.
entries.status_note: Supported assets differ by pool and chain; check current limits and pause flags.

entries.name: Vesu
entries.description: Starknet lending pools and curated vault infrastructure within the Bitcoin staking ecosystem.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Pool-specific collateral contracts on Starknet.
entries.review_focus: Accepted BTC representation, oracle, liquidation and curator configuration.
entries.status_note: Endur lists Vesu as an integration; no individual BTC market or rate is certified here.

entries.name: Zest Protocol
entries.description: Stacks lending markets and a separately described Bitcoin Collateral Vault initiative.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: sBTC-based lending; proposed/native-vault paths have different mechanics.
entries.review_focus: Liquidations, price oracles, sBTC signers and the deployment stage of each vault product.
entries.status_note: Existing Stacks markets must not be conflated with new vault architecture.

entries.name: Arkadiko
entries.description: Stablecoin and DeFi system whose USDA vaults are described as STX-collateralized.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Stacks collateral contracts and oracle-dependent debt positions.
entries.review_focus: STX volatility, collateral ratios, liquidations and contract controls.
entries.status_note: Bitcoin-ecosystem inclusion does not mean USDA is directly backed by BTC.

entries.name: BTCFi (Bifrost)
entries.description: Bitcoin-collateralized borrowing service and related BtcUSD ecosystem.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Product-specific collateral arrangements supporting native BTC and BTC representations.
entries.review_focus: Collateral custody, supported routes, liquidation rules and stablecoin redemption.
entries.status_note: A specific product brand, distinct from the general term BTCfi; the source lists BTC, WBTC, BTCB and cbBTC collateral.

entries.name: ctUSD
entries.description: Dollar stablecoin within the Citrea ecosystem described as backed by cash and short-term Treasury bills.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: External fiat reserves and tokens on Citrea.
entries.review_focus: Issuer, reserves, redemption eligibility and chain risk.
entries.status_note: Not BTC-collateralized despite use in Bitcoin capital markets.

entries.name: Ducat / UNIT
entries.description: BTC-backed stablecoin design using collateral vaults and MPC-coordinated rules.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Native BTC collateral plus external guardians, oracles and protocol nodes.
entries.review_focus: Guardian/signing assumptions, liquidation path, oracle integrity and deployment stage.
entries.status_note: BTC-native branding is not a claim that Bitcoin alone enforces every stablecoin rule.

entries.name: Hermetica
entries.description: USDh synthetic-dollar product and hBTC Bitcoin yield strategies.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Strategy-managed financial exposure delivered through ecosystem assets.
entries.review_focus: Hedging and custody arrangements, counterparties, liquidity and product-specific redemption.
entries.status_note: Included from Stacks' official ecosystem report; current detailed product mechanics need direct-document review.

entries.name: Mezo
entries.description: Bitcoin finance platform with BTC-backed MUSD borrowing and yield-vault access.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Bitcoin-linked collateral on Mezo and application-specific debt/vault contracts.
entries.review_focus: Collateral bridge, liquidation and redemption rules; vaults add curator risk.
entries.status_note: MUSD's dollar target is distinct from holding BTC; Upshift-powered vaults are a separate product.

entries.name: Money On Chain
entries.description: DOC dollar exposure and BPRO Bitcoin exposure within a shared collateral system.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Bitcoin-linked collateral on Rootstock with risk allocated between token classes.
entries.review_focus: RBTC peg, collateral model, oracles and BPRO exposure.
entries.status_note: BPRO is a risk-bearing product, not a plain BTC deposit.

entries.name: Sovryn Zero
entries.description: BTC-backed stablecoin borrowing within the Sovryn ecosystem.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: RBTC collateral, stablecoin debt and a liquidation stability pool.
entries.review_focus: Origination fees, redemptions, collateral ratio and liquidation.
entries.status_note: The page includes DLLR and older ZUSD language; verify the current app and docs before interpreting terms.

entries.name: ALEX
entries.description: Stacks DeFi suite with liquidity and exchange functionality.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Stacks contracts and associated ecosystem assets.
entries.review_focus: Incident history, paused functions, contract versions and current recovery information.
entries.status_note: Ecosystem listing establishes identity, not present operational health.

entries.name: Bitflow
entries.description: Exchange and liquidity infrastructure for Stacks assets including sBTC pairs.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Stacks smart-contract liquidity pools.
entries.review_focus: sBTC backing, pool design, price ranges, impermanent loss and contract risk.
entries.status_note: Official Stacks source describes sBTC/USDCx liquidity activity.

entries.name: Curve
entries.description: Liquidity pools and related DeFi infrastructure used with tokenized Bitcoin.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Automated market makers on destination chains.
entries.review_focus: Pool composition, wrapper depegs, liquidity, impermanent loss and contracts.
entries.status_note: WBTC's official site lists Curve among supported trading venues; verify the particular pool.

entries.name: Flashnet
entries.description: Bitcoin trading and payment orchestration infrastructure with native-asset routing.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Route-dependent exchange, bridge and settlement integrations.
entries.review_focus: Route composition, provider trust, underlying payment layer and settlement recovery.
entries.status_note: Spark identifies Flashnet as an ecosystem integration; route guarantees should be checked individually.

entries.name: JuiceSwap
entries.description: Exchange listed among Citrea's Bitcoin applications.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Citrea application contracts and assets.
entries.review_focus: Pool deployment, liquidity, contract review and bridge dependencies.
entries.status_note: Listed from the network's official directory; no execution testing performed.

entries.name: LN Markets
entries.description: Bitcoin derivatives interface using Lightning and external exchange liquidity.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Lightning funding combined with platform-managed trading infrastructure.
entries.review_focus: Margin liquidation, platform custody, execution and exchange counterparties.
entries.status_note: Lightning deposits do not turn a derivatives venue into a self-custodial protocol.

entries.name: Satsuma
entries.description: Exchange listed in Citrea's application ecosystem.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Citrea application contracts and assets.
entries.review_focus: Pool deployment, liquidity, contract review and cBTC bridge dependencies.
entries.status_note: Identity and category confirmed by Citrea; detailed product due diligence remains open.

entries.name: SideSwap
entries.description: Peer-to-peer swaps and settlement tools for Liquid assets.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Liquid asset transactions and L-BTC peg access.
entries.review_focus: Liquid federation, individual asset issuers and market liquidity.
entries.status_note: Non-custodial trading does not remove the underlying Liquid peg assumptions.

entries.name: UniSat
entries.description: Wallet, marketplace and data tools for Bitcoin asset protocols.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Ordinal, BRC-20, Rune and Alkane-aware transaction and indexing systems.
entries.review_focus: Asset-indexer correctness, signing, UTXO selection and marketplace liquidity.
entries.status_note: Features on Fractal use a different network from Bitcoin mainnet.

entries.name: Uniswap
entries.description: General-purpose exchange infrastructure with tokenized BTC markets.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Version-specific automated market makers and, in v4, optional hooks.
entries.review_focus: Token authenticity, LP price ranges, wrapper risk and any pool-specific hook.
entries.status_note: BTC trading uses a representation such as WBTC, not native Bitcoin settlement.

entries.name: Bedrock
entries.description: uniBTC and brBTC alongside a broader Bitcoin yield-vault product suite.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: BTC representations routed into product-specific strategies.
entries.review_focus: Custody, token backing, contracts and off-chain strategy dependencies.
entries.status_note: Current site describes Bedrock 2.0, including lending, derivatives and RWA strategies beyond staking.

entries.name: Lombard LBTC
entries.description: Yield-bearing BTC asset now tied to a Bitwise-managed covered-call strategy.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Custodied BTC backing and non-rebasing tokens with an exchange rate.
entries.review_focus: Options losses, counterparties, custody and redemption delays.
entries.status_note: Docs say Babylon backing ended in August 2026 and the new strategy started August 17; do not describe today's LBTC as simply a Babylon LST.

entries.name: Lorenzo Protocol
entries.description: Bitcoin liquidity and asset-management infrastructure, including stBTC-related designs.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Tokenized BTC principal or yield exposure and strategy-specific backing.
entries.review_focus: Current product scope, custody, receipt-token rights and redemption availability.
entries.status_note: Public Bitcoin-liquidity documentation exists; current front-end availability is not certified.

entries.name: Pendle
entries.description: Yield tokenization and trading usable with supported Bitcoin yield assets.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Principal and yield claims on an underlying yield-bearing token.
entries.review_focus: Underlying protocol and wrapper risk, maturity, liquidity and yield-token decay.
entries.status_note: BTC market availability changes; inspect the specific underlying asset and expiry.

entries.name: Solv Protocol
entries.description: SolvBTC representation, xSolvBTC yield exposure and managed BTC strategies.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Product-specific custody, reserve and strategy arrangements.
entries.review_focus: Backing composition, manager permissions, counterparties and redemption terms.
entries.status_note: SolvBTC, xSolvBTC and BTC+ should not be treated as identical products.

entries.name: Spectra
entries.description: Permissionless yield markets and vault infrastructure, including Bitcoin-related ecosystem use.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Separate principal/yield claims and interest-rate markets.
entries.review_focus: Underlying backing, maturity, curator choices and secondary-market liquidity.
entries.status_note: Hemi is among the networks shown; each BTC market needs independent verification.

entries.name: YieldBasis
entries.description: Liquidity strategy designed to offset impermanent loss for tokenized BTC and ETH.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Leveraged liquidity positions rather than Bitcoin consensus rewards.
entries.review_focus: Leverage, borrowing costs, rebalancing, wrapper backing and pool losses.
entries.status_note: The design's leverage is economically material; claims of eliminating IL do not eliminate all losses.

entries.name: Atomiq
entries.description: Atomic swaps between Bitcoin and supported smart-contract chains.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Escrow contracts, Bitcoin light-client verification and refund paths.
entries.review_focus: Light-client implementation, swap expiry, smart contracts and counterparty liquidity.
entries.status_note: The site documents both on-chain Bitcoin and Lightning routes.

entries.name: Boltz
entries.description: Submarine and chain swaps across Bitcoin payment layers, with additional stablecoin routes.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Atomic-swap contracts and route-specific execution legs.
entries.review_focus: Refund backups, timeouts, fees and any extra DEX or bridge used by a route.
entries.status_note: Stablecoin routes can compose additional components beyond a basic BTC-to-Lightning swap.

entries.name: Chainflip
entries.description: Native-asset cross-chain swaps with liquidity, Boost and lending products.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Validator MPC custody and cross-chain execution.
entries.review_focus: Validator security, custody, confirmation risk and product-specific lending terms.
entries.status_note: Swap, Boost and lending exposures have different risk profiles.

entries.name: Garden
entries.description: Atomic-swap infrastructure and APIs connecting Bitcoin with other networks.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Chain-specific swap contracts and liquidity providers.
entries.review_focus: Timeouts, refund implementation, provider liquidity and destination-chain contracts.
entries.status_note: Swap contracts and supported chain routes are documented separately.

entries.name: LendaSwap
entries.description: Bitcoin-to-stablecoin swaps associated with Lendasat.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Route-specific swaps using Bitcoin payment layers.
entries.review_focus: Exact route, timeout/recovery behavior and stablecoin issuer.
entries.status_note: Product directory describes Lightning and Arkade integration; distinct from Lendasat loans.

entries.name: THORChain
entries.description: Cross-chain exchange and liquidity infrastructure for native assets including BTC.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Threshold-controlled network vaults and pool-based exchange.
entries.review_focus: Validator economics, vault custody, pool exposure and network halts.
entries.status_note: Native-asset swaps still have network custody assumptions; distinguish swap pools from historical lending products.

entries.name: Amboss
entries.description: Bitcoin payment infrastructure and integration tooling.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Lightning-connected payment routes and receiving-wallet integrations.
entries.review_focus: Wallet custody choice, route support and service availability.
entries.status_note: Current homepage emphasizes payment APIs; legacy product names need separate verification.

entries.name: Arkade
entries.description: Ark-based toolkit for payments, programmable transaction flows and asset exchange.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Bitcoin transaction structures coordinated through Arkade.
entries.review_focus: Operator availability, committed recovery paths and implementation-specific assumptions.
entries.status_note: Homepage labels Intents as developer preview; do not treat every feature as production-ready.

entries.name: Cashu
entries.description: Open Chaumian ecash protocol with Bitcoin-linked mints and wallets.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Bearer claims issued by mints, commonly funded over Lightning.
entries.review_focus: Mint solvency, issuer trust and token loss or double spending.
entries.status_note: Each mint is its own trust relationship.

entries.name: Fedimint
entries.description: Federated ecash for Bitcoin payments and community custody.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Federation custody backing private ecash notes.
entries.review_focus: Guardian collusion, solvency, federation availability and exit liquidity.
entries.status_note: Privacy and distributed custody do not make ecash self-custodial BTC.

entries.name: Lightning Loop
entries.description: Submarine swaps for moving value between Lightning and on-chain Bitcoin.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: HTLC-based swaps and refund conditions.
entries.review_focus: Fees, timeout handling, liquidity and transaction monitoring.
entries.status_note: Channel management service; not a passive yield product.

entries.name: Lightning Pool
entries.description: Marketplace for leasing Lightning channel liquidity.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Bitcoin allocated to payment-channel capacity.
entries.review_focus: Channel demand, node uptime, lease terms, fees and operational costs.
entries.status_note: Liquidity fees are a different source of return from lending or staking.

entries.name: Mercury Layer
entries.description: Statechain implementation using blinded co-signing and key updates.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: UTXO ownership transfers supported by a key-share service.
entries.review_focus: Server key deletion/update assumptions, backup transactions and exit timelocks.
entries.status_note: Implementation documentation reviewed; current service availability not transaction-tested.

entries.name: Second
entries.description: Ark implementation and SDKs connecting Ark, Lightning and on-chain payments.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Ark virtual UTXOs and implementation-specific transfer/recovery paths.
entries.review_focus: Server availability, VTXO expiry, backups and exit fees.
entries.status_note: Official homepage announces mainnet; no payment testing performed.

entries.name: Spark
entries.description: Bitcoin and asset payment infrastructure with Lightning connectivity.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Statechain-style transfers and an operator-assisted Bitcoin ownership system.
entries.review_focus: Operator and key-share assumptions, unilateral exit details and issued-asset backing.
entries.status_note: Distinct from the Spark DeFi lending/savings brand on Ethereum.

entries.name: Bitlight Wallet
entries.description: Wallet for Bitcoin and RGB assets, with asset issuance tooling.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Client-side RGB state and Bitcoin wallet functionality.
entries.review_focus: Asset proofs, issuer authenticity, backups and version compatibility.
entries.status_note: RGB assets require more than a BTC-only recovery assumption.

entries.name: Leather
entries.description: Wallet for Bitcoin, Stacks assets and ecosystem applications.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Bitcoin and Stacks transaction signing.
entries.review_focus: Backups, hardware-wallet compatibility and application approvals.
entries.status_note: Access layer rather than an independent source of yield.

entries.name: Xverse
entries.description: Wallet and application gateway for Bitcoin assets and connected financial services.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: User signing plus integrations with distinct Bitcoin-related networks.
entries.review_focus: Recovery, signing permissions and the trust model of each connected service.
entries.status_note: Wallet self-custody does not guarantee self-custody after depositing into an application.

entries.name: Bitcoin Dev Kit
entries.description: Libraries for Bitcoin wallet and transaction applications.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Bitcoin descriptors, transaction construction and chain access.
entries.review_focus: Key handling, dependency versions and application security.
entries.status_note: Developer infrastructure, not a financial service.

entries.name: Bitcoin-S
entries.description: Scala libraries and tooling for Bitcoin transaction applications.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Bitcoin and Lightning data structures and transaction APIs.
entries.review_focus: Application design, signing and maintained library versions.
entries.status_note: Useful building block for Bitcoin financial software.

entries.name: Breez SDK
entries.description: SDKs for embedding Bitcoin payments into applications.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Implementation-dependent Bitcoin payment-layer integrations.
entries.review_focus: Which SDK implementation is used, recovery, providers and payment liquidity.
entries.status_note: Different SDK backends have different trust and availability properties.

entries.name: Elements
entries.description: Sidechain-capable software with confidential transactions and asset issuance.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Independent or pegged chains with configurable consensus.
entries.review_focus: Operator model, peg construction and issued-asset obligations.
entries.status_note: Software capability does not certify any chain built from it.

entries.name: LayerEdge
entries.description: Proof aggregation and anchoring infrastructure for external applications.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Aggregated proofs anchored to underlying networks.
entries.review_focus: Anchoring versus actual enforcement, verifier design and deployment stage.
entries.status_note: Do not equate publishing a proof commitment with inheriting all Bitcoin security properties.

entries.name: Lightning Dev Kit
entries.description: Modular Lightning implementation and SDK for applications.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Payment-channel logic integrated into the host application.
entries.review_focus: Persistence, channel monitoring and integration correctness.
entries.status_note: Developers choose their own operational architecture.

entries.name: Metashrew
entries.description: WASM-powered indexing framework for Bitcoin metaprotocols.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Block processing and application-defined indexer logic.
entries.review_focus: Indexer implementation, reorg handling and state agreement.
entries.status_note: Indexing a contract is different from Bitcoin consensus enforcing its full semantics.

entries.name: Nubit / Bitcoin Thunderbolt
entries.description: Bitcoin transfer and programmability project now described around Thunderbolt.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Off-chain UTXO ownership changes with threshold-signing committees.
entries.review_focus: Committee assumptions, implementation maturity and enforceable exits.
entries.status_note: Older descriptions focused only on data availability are incomplete.

entries.name: Rebar Labs
entries.description: Bitcoin APIs, metaprotocol data and transaction-submission tools with MEV-focused features.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Bitcoin indexing and transaction-flow infrastructure.
entries.review_focus: Data accuracy, transaction visibility and service dependence.
entries.status_note: Earn, Shield and data products need separate evaluation; no yield claim is inferred from API access.

entries.name: Babylon ecosystem
entries.description: Official discovery map for staking providers and connected infrastructure.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Ecosystem self-reporting.
entries.review_focus: Distinguish direct staking, liquid wrappers and infrastructure providers.
entries.status_note: Partner inclusion is not an audit or endorsement by this list.

entries.name: Bitcoin Layers
entries.description: Independent directory analyzing Bitcoin layers, BTC representations and trust assumptions.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Research rather than custody or execution infrastructure.
entries.review_focus: Methodology, assessment date and scope of each project review.
entries.status_note: A useful counterweight to project marketing; classifications can evolve.

entries.name: Bitcoin Layers methodology
entries.description: Framework covering data availability, operators, settlement and bridge custody.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Structured risk analysis.
entries.review_focus: Apply dimensions separately; avoid turning a label into a universal safety score.
entries.status_note: Used as a research lens, not reproduced as a rating system.

entries.name: DefiLlama Bitcoin dashboard
entries.description: Protocol discovery and metrics for projects classified under Bitcoin.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Aggregator adapters and category definitions.
entries.review_focus: Double counting, classifications, adapter coverage and TVL versus deposited BTC.
entries.status_note: Bitcoin-linked assets on other chains require additional dashboards; no static TVL ranking is copied here.

entries.name: SoK: Bitcoin Layer Two
entries.description: Research paper surveying Bitcoin layer-two constructions and tradeoffs.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Academic systematization.
entries.review_focus: Paper version and gap between design and deployed implementation.
entries.status_note: Complements current project documentation; not a live product directory.

entries.name: Stacks ecosystem
entries.description: Official application, wallet and developer-tool discovery map.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Ecosystem self-reporting.
entries.review_focus: A listing is not a security review or current service guarantee.
entries.status_note: Used for discovery and cross-checking relevance.

entries.name: Bima
entries.description: Structured financing against digital assets with an agreed upside-sharing component.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Accountable vault infrastructure and FalconX-held collateral in the documented arrangement.
entries.review_focus: Counterparty and derivative terms, downside exposure and foregone upside.
entries.status_note: Current docs describe institutional structured financing; do not assume the older stablecoin framing still applies.

entries.name: BounceBit
entries.description: CeDeFi platform combining custodied assets, managed strategies and an EVM settlement chain.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: BB-tokens backed through external custody and investment arrangements.
entries.review_focus: Custodian and exchange exposure, manager risk and withdrawal terms.
entries.status_note: Listed as hybrid/centralized finance rather than Bitcoin-native non-custodial staking.

entries.name: exSat
entries.description: Digital-asset banking platform offering qualified-access custody, payments and strategy products.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Custody and managed strategies alongside Bitcoin-related infrastructure.
entries.review_focus: Eligibility, legal counterparties, strategy leverage and redemption windows.
entries.status_note: Current homepage emphasizes digital banking rather than only a Bitcoin scaling layer.

entries.name: Ledn
entries.description: Centralized Bitcoin-backed loans and related credit products.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Contractual loans with collateral held through custody arrangements.
entries.review_focus: Custody, lender solvency, loan terms, liquidation and jurisdiction.
entries.status_note: CeFi comparison entry; no claim that collateral is controlled solely by the borrower.

entries.name: Unchained
entries.description: Bitcoin financial services built around collaborative custody.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Multisignature arrangements and product-specific financial contracts.
entries.review_focus: Key roles, service eligibility and the terms of each product.
entries.status_note: Custody services and borrowing products should be evaluated separately.

entries.name: Botanix
entries.description: Historical Bitcoin EVM ecosystem associated with the Spiderchain design.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Federated/sidechain execution and Bitcoin bridge arrangements.
entries.review_focus: Shutdown information and any remaining asset-recovery routes.
entries.status_note: Official site announces shutdown on July 1, 2026. Retained for historical context, not new deposits.

entries.name: pSTAKE
entries.description: Former Bitcoin/liquid-staking project whose current site presents a research collective.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Historical staking products with separate deprecation flows.
entries.review_focus: Legacy withdrawal instructions and product-specific closure status.
entries.status_note: Staking links now point to deprecation.pstake.finance; site focuses on Web3/AI research.

entries.name: Tropykus
entries.description: Historical Rootstock lending application.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Rootstock smart-contract lending pools.
entries.review_focus: Remaining contract interactions and recovery instructions.
entries.status_note: Official site says interface closed July 27 and support ended August 31, 2026; contracts may remain accessible.

entries.name: Yala
entries.description: Previously included in BTCfi stablecoin maps; current site presents prediction-market intelligence.
entries.bitcoin_mechanism: Legacy BTCfi products require separate redemption and backing review.
entries.review_focus: Legacy redemption availability, obligations and updated product scope.
entries.status_note: Homepage now describes an AI fair-value agent and retains a Redeem link; current YU minting was not established.
